concerns.text: The plan drops the visual-encoder component of FR-001/FR-004 and replaces visual latents with text-derived structural features, but the constitution's Principle VII makes 'visual layout latents (generated by a frozen visual encoder)' the project's primary scientific contribution, and the spec (FR-001, US-1) still mandates it. The plan itself admits 'The spec should be amended at the next clarification pass' — but no amendment exists yet, so plan, spec, and constitution currently disagree on the core mechanism. Downstream task verification against the unamended spec FR-001 will fail. Either amend the spec/constitution (scope-limitation clause for Principle VII) before plan acceptance, or route this through the clarification pass now.

Data-model defines StructuralLatent as a separate entity keyed by doc_id, but the schema and data flow embed the latent as an optional `structural_latent` column inside DocumentPair (document_pairs_with_latent.parquet). These are two different representations; pick one (or state the parquet column is the serialized form of the StructuralLatent entity) so contract tests and the data model agree.

Plan/research use Bonferroni α = 0.025 for the two primary hypotheses, while spec SC-003 defines success as p < 0.05. The plan should explicitly note the Bonferroni-corrected threshold is stricter than and consistent with SC-003's 0.05 standard, or the discrepancy will look like a contract mismatch at task-verification time.
